Container.Name: Rexarr
Container.Overview: Remux-first transcoding companion for the *arr stack. Rexarr finds Blu-ray remuxes and full discs for Radarr and Sonarr, re-encodes what they import with FFmpeg using profiles you control, rips DVDs and Blu-rays with MakeMKV, and handles music through Lidarr and fre:ac. Mount your media at the SAME path Radarr and Sonarr use (/data here, as in the TRaSH guides) so no path mapping is needed. Disc ripping needs makemkvcon, which may not be redistributed, so this image cannot rip: build docker/Dockerfile.makemkv yourself if you want it. Everything else works out of the box. Documentation: https://moonlightlaboratory.github.io/rexarr/

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, profiles, history, cache and logs. Keep this on the cache pool, not on a share.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media, mounted at the same path Radarr / Sonarr see it (/data).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Rexarr runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask for everything Rexarr writes.

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Pass /dev/dri for Intel QuickSync / VAAPI hardware encoding.

Config.Name: Optical drive
Config.Description: DVD / Blu-ray drive. Needs an image with MakeMKV in it (docker/Dockerfile.makemkv); add /dev/sg0 as well for Blu-ray.

Config.Name: Optical drive (SCSI node)
Config.Description: The generic SCSI node of the same drive, needed by MakeMKV for Blu-ray.
